question: What is the main goal of indirect nursing care technologies?
explanation: Indirect care tech handles behind-the-scenes duties like tracking supplies and admin work, giving nurses more time for hands-on care. You've got this! [learn more](GNS113_U4_T5#GNS113_U4_T5_h1)

question: How do indirect nursing care technologies help improve patient care?

options.A: By eliminating the need for patient medical records
options.B: By shortening the duration of physician ward rounds
options.C: By replacing bedside nurses with automated machines
options.D: By reducing the administrative burden on clinical staff

explanation: Cutting down on stress and paperwork means nurses can focus better on patient safety and comfort. Great job thinking this through! [learn more](GNS113_U4_T5#GNS113_U4_T5_h1)

question: Why do hospitals use RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) technology?

options.A: To calculate monthly staff payroll accurately
options.B: To locate mobile medical equipment quickly
options.C: To analyze patient dietary nutritional intake
options.D: To diagnose infectious diseases in the laboratory

explanation: RFID tags act like trackers for portable items such as infusion pumps, saving you time running around looking for gear across wards. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T5#GNS113_U4_T5_h2)

question: A nurse scans an RFID-enabled wristband primarily for which safety check?

options.A: Verifying patient identity during care activities
options.B: Recording the patient's vital signs automatically
options.C: Measuring the patient's daily fluid balance output
options.D: Tracking the patient's physical exercise routine

explanation: Patient safety starts with getting the right person! RFID wristbands make quick, accurate ID checks before you give meds or treatments. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T5#GNS113_U4_T5_h2)

question: What is the primary job of an electronic inventory system in a hospital?

options.A: Scheduling yearly vacations for the nursing workforce
options.B: Automating the tracking of hospital consumables and supplies
options.C: Managing electronic medical records of discharged patients
options.D: Evaluating the clinical competence of student nurses

explanation: These systems keep an eye on stock levels so wards don't suddenly run out of basic supplies. Simple and super helpful! [learn more](GNS113_U4_T5#GNS113_U4_T5_h3)

question: Why are electronic inventory systems so helpful in busy or low-resource clinical settings?

options.A: They reduce the market price of pharmaceutical drugs
options.B: They prevent unexpected stock-outs of essential items
options.C: They completely eliminate the need for hospital storekeepers
options.D: They allow patients to purchase supplies from home

explanation: Catching low supplies early means no last-minute panic when you urgently need lifesaving items. You're building great clinical insight! [learn more](GNS113_U4_T5#GNS113_U4_T5_h3)

question: Computerized staffing systems are mainly built to help with which task?

options.A: Processing health insurance claims for patients
options.C: Generating fair and safe duty rosters

explanation: Duty rosters can be a headache! Software helps match the number of nurses on duty with actual patient care needs. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T5#GNS113_U4_T5_h4)

question: What is a common misunderstanding about computerized staffing systems in healthcare?

options.A: They remove human judgment entirely from scheduling
options.B: They automatically increase nurses' base salaries
options.C: They increase the total number of hospital patients
options.D: They require continuous internet access to function

explanation: Computers give helpful suggestions, but human managers always have the final say on duty schedules. Good to know for clinical practice! [learn more](GNS113_U4_T5#GNS113_U4_T5_h4)

question: Which issue is a major challenge for setting up new technology in many Nigerian hospitals?

options.A: A complete lack of patients requiring hospital care
options.B: An excessive surplus of modern computer hardware
options.C: Zero interest from nurses in learning new skills
options.D: Inconsistent power supply and internet connectivity

explanation: PHCN light issues and unstable network signals are real hurdles when trying to keep digital systems running smoothly here at home. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T5#GNS113_U4_T5_h5)

question: What is most important for making sure new hospital technology is adopted successfully by staff?

options.A: Removing paper records without any digital backups
options.B: Staff digital literacy training and change management
options.C: Increasing the number of daily administrative meetings
options.D: Replacing all senior nurses with junior technical staff

explanation: Tools only work well if staff know how to use them! Proper training and steady support make new tech feel easy, not scary. [learn more](GNS113_U4_T5#GNS113_U4_T5_h5)
